target_customer: Developers of renewable and energy infrastructure projects, mainly in Europe, who must find and vet land and grid access
problem: Choosing a site means checking dozens of geospatial, grid and regulatory constraints spread across fragmented data sources, which takes developers months.
business_model: B2B SaaS platform for energy developers
product_category: AI geospatial site selection for energy infrastructure

founders.name: Marc Watine
founders.role: CEO (per YC page, listed as Marc W.)
education: Harvard (researcher in geospatial data and AI, per tech.eu)
founders.background_notes: tech.eu calls him an ex-Harvard researcher in geospatial data and AI; YC page lists him as Marc W.

founders.name: Edouard Labarthe
founders.role: COO per YC page, CEO per tech.eu
founders.background_notes: Described as ex-Palantir by tech.eu. Role differs between sources.

competitors.name: Nira Energy
competitors.what: Grid and site selection analytics for renewable developers
competitors.traction_then: YC directory says customers include AES and Cypress Creek

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs aggregation of 50+ fragmented geospatial, grid and regulatory sources plus a natural language query layer; heavy data engineering but standard LLM tooling in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: Value sits in curated country by country data pipelines, but similar tools (Nira, LandGate) existed and LLM interfaces are easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action found as of 2026.

market_need_then: Renewable developers faced slow permitting and grid queue bottlenecks in 2024; company cites calls with about sixty French renewable developers as basis for its ROI model.

branding.domain_note: Site runs on plumefinder.com, not plume.com, suggesting the exact word was taken.

identity.voice_and_tone: bold and direct, speed and fewer surprises

branding.brand_signature: Tagline 'Make each MW easier to deploy' and comparison to a Bloomberg Terminal for energy development (a testimonial)

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself found; name shared with several other Plume companies.

outcome_analysis: Plume is active and raised a reported 3.3 million euro seed in April 2026, about twenty months after its Summer 2024 batch, led by AENU with YC and Kima. It sells to renewable developers facing permitting and grid bottlenecks across several European countries. No exit, layoffs or shutdown were found. Direct competitors such as Nira Energy existed earlier, so differentiation rests on natural language access and European coverage.
notes: Total raised reported as 3.9M USD on company site and 3.3M EUR in tech.eu; USD amount left null because the conversion is not stated in the cited source. Aggregators disagree on totals (about 3M to 4.9M USD). Name origin not found. No outcome news found.
